data.gender_notes: Adelardo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Adelardo is derived from the Germanic elements ‘adal’ meaning noble and ‘hard’ meaning strong or hardy. It was a common name among the Germanic peoples and was also adopted by the Spanish and Portuguese. In the Middle Ages, it was a popular name for noblemen and knights. The name Adelardo carries the meaning “Noble, nobleman” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Adelardo usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, nobleman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adelardo total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Adelardo was a common name among the Germanic peoples and was also adopted by the Spanish and Portuguese. It was a symbol of nobility and strength, reflecting the ideals of chivalry and feudal society. In Spain, the name was associated with the Reconquista, the long struggle to reclaim territory from the Moors. The name Adelardo continues to be used in Spain and other Spanish-speaking countries, and is considered a respectable and dignified name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Adelardo is derived from the Germanic elements ‘adal’ meaning noble and ‘hard’ meaning strong or hardy. These elements have spiritual significance as they reflect the innate goodness and strength of human beings, created in the image and likeness of God. The name Adelardo can be seen as a reminder of the call to be noble and strong in faith, to persevere in the face of adversity and to uphold the virtues of justice, courage, and integrity. In the spiritual realm, the name Adelardo can be seen as a reminder of the power of God to grant us strength and nobility in the face of challenges, and to help us live out our vocation in a Dionysian and heroic manner.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adelardo: Noble and light-hearted. A name rooted in the noble Germanic tradition, symbolizing strength, courage, and wisdom, while its lightheartedness represents a joyful and optimistic spirit.
